positions.title: Software Developer - Performance Testing Team
positions.description:
Automated and manual testing and debugging of software systems in RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu environments.
Creating custom performance tests with JMeter and our in-house Testify tool suite.
Improved testing of our deployment of Testify with Vagrant.
Testify work extensively uses Ruby with rspec or ActiveSupport TestCase, MongoDB, and Puppet. Debugging of Ruby, Perl, Puppet, Java code from other teams.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research work in Netserv, a hot-pluggable modular router architecture built using Java.
Performance and overhead testing using Click software router and Juniper hardware routers.
Network coding in creating hot-pluggable modules for the architecture.

Srinivasan, S., Lee, J.W., Liu, E., et.al.  NetServ: Dynamically Deploying In-network Services.  ACM ReArch ’09.
